title: 第19章 出名了第20章 拒绝
lines: 第19章出名了
庞老师那张普通的脸上带着微笑，看着白牧野。
班上的同学也全都朝白牧野这边看过来。
尽管大部分人都在勉强控制，但眼神里的怪异依然不可遏制的释放出来。
官宣白牧野不行？
这算是官方“判死刑”吗？
白牧野愣了一下，有些茫然的看了一眼老师。
心说我怎么了？
他从来没觉得自己精神力弱，所以第一时间居然没能反应过来。
单谷和姬彩衣等人直接皱起眉头，心里面很不舒服。
可以举例的人那么多，为什么非要拿白牧野开刀？
他招惹你了？
白牧野的能力你见识过吗？
凭借二十点精神力，就能画出力量、迟缓、敏捷和控制这四种辅助型符篆。
在这个年龄，有几个人能做到？
再说了，历史上那种前期天赋一般，后期爆发的例子虽然很少，但并非没有。
作为一名老师，凭什么这样当面否定白牧野？
那边的穆锡，嘴角露出淡淡的不屑微笑。
渣就是渣，没人说就不渣了？
“白牧野同学，不介意我拿你给同学们举个例子吧？”
庞老师一脸温和，虽然他长的一般，但多年的教书生涯让他身上带着一股书卷气，感觉不到任何对白牧野的嘲讽。
白牧野露出微笑：“介意呀。”
“不介意就……咳咳。”
庞老师被狠狠的晃了一下，看着那张特别帅地脸上露出的微笑，感觉十分刺眼。
班上的大部分同学也被噎得够呛，忍不住暗中佩服白牧野的勇气。
换做是他们，恐怕未必敢这样回答。
穆锡也一脸惊讶的看着白牧野，心说你不知道自己很菜？居然还可以这样不要脸吗？
白牧野眨眨眼，很平静的说道：“但就算我介意，老师您也不能把这话收回去，所以，我还是假装不介意吧。这样您心里还能好受点是吧？嗯，请继续讲课，别耽误大家时间，我还想听呢，老师课讲的很好。”
噗！
单谷第一个忍不住，直接笑出声来。
随后班级传来一阵低低的哄笑。
这回答，真的很牛逼！
庞老师一脸尴尬，心说我好受个鬼？
深吸了一口气，他说道：“其实老师没有嘲讽任何人的意思，只是想告诉你们一个事实。之所以用身边的人举例子，是想让你们更加直观的明白这个道理。”
强行解释一波，庞老师再次一脸真诚的看着白牧野：“虽然我的话比较刺耳，但实话实说，就算你再怎么努力，用再多的资源去堆砌，终其一生，你都没机会成长为宗师级的符篆师！”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Become famous
Teacher Pang looked at Bai Muye with a smile on his ordinary face.
All the students in the class also looked towards Bai Muye.
Although most people are barely controlling it, the weirdness in their eyes is still uncontrollably released.
Isn’t it okay to officially announce Bai Muye?
Is this an official "death sentence"?
Bai Muye was stunned for a moment and glanced at the teacher in confusion.
My heart says what’s wrong with me?
He had never felt that he was mentally weak, so he was unable to react immediately.
Shan Gu, Ji Caiyi and others frowned, feeling very uncomfortable.
There are so many people who can give examples, why do you have to target Bai Muye?
Did he provoke you?
Have you seen Bai Muye's ability?
With twenty points of spiritual power, you can draw four auxiliary talismans: strength, slowness, agility and control.
At this age, how many people can do it?
Besides, there are few examples in history of average talent in the early stage and explosive growth in the later stage, but they are not unheard of.
As a teacher, why should I deny Bai Muye to his face like this?
Mu Xi over there had a faint smile of disdain on his lips.
A scumbag is a scumbag, no one says he will stop being a scumbag?
"Classmate Bai Muye, do you mind if I use you as an example to my classmates?"
Teacher Pang has a gentle face. Although he is average-looking, his many years of teaching career have given him a bookish air, and he does not feel any ridicule towards Bai Muye.
Bai Muye smiled: "I don't mind."
"If you don't mind...ahem."
Teacher Pang was shaken violently. Looking at the smile on that particularly handsome face, he felt very dazzling.
Most of the students in the class were choked so much that they couldn't help but secretly admire Bai Muye's courage.
If it were them, they might not dare to answer like this.
Mu Xi also looked at Bai Muye with a surprised look on his face and said to himself, "Don't you know you are a bad guy?" Can you still be so shameless?
Bai Muye blinked and said calmly: "But even if I mind, teacher you can't take it back, so I'd better pretend that I don't mind. This will make you feel better, right? Well, please continue teaching and don't waste everyone's time. I still want to listen. The teacher's lecture is very good."
Poof!
Shan Gu was the first to hold back and burst out laughing.
Then there was a low roar of laughter from the class.
This answer is really awesome!
Teacher Pang had an embarrassed look on his face and thought, "I'm so miserable?"
Taking a deep breath, he said: "Actually, the teacher didn't mean to ridicule anyone, he just wanted to tell you a fact. The reason why I used people around me as examples is to let you understand this truth more intuitively."
After forcing an explanation, Teacher Pang once again looked at Bai Muye with a sincere face: "Although my words are harsh, but to be honest, no matter how hard you work and no matter how much resources you use to pile up, you will never have the chance to grow into a master-level talisman seal master in your lifetime!"
